title: Whole-Site Product Coherence Ledger
raw_request: Draft the Whole-Site Product Coherence Ledger as a queue-ready spec, preferably with JSON machine state plus HTML evidence reports, but do not add it to the queue unless explicitly asked.
goal: Create a read-only audit and evidence system that continuously maps every meaningful ChefFlow route, role surface, navigation entry, workflow promise, action path, data dependency, proof state, and queue implication into one machine-readable coherence ledger plus human-readable HTML evidence reports.

included: Route inventory across public, chef, client, admin, staff, partner, vendor, API, and special route groups.

Navigation, rail, command surface, dashboard, Page X-Ray, Remy, CIL, Priority Queue, ledger, communications, lifecycle, menu intelligence, PIE, client intelligence, Dinner Circles, automation, and universal rail implications where detectable.
Runtime probes against canonical http://localhost:3100 for probeable routes.
Browser screenshot/DOM evidence for sampled critical surfaces.
Queue mapping and queue-candidate output without automatic queue insertion.
excluded: Deleting or rewriting unrelated dirty workspace artifacts.
Adding the spec to the build queue without explicit user approval.

requirements: Evidence thumbnails linked to local screenshots.
Clickable links to source files and queue items.
No secrets, cookies, tokens, PII, or private client data.
Runtime status, console/network caveats, screenshots, and open gaps.

acceptance_criteria: The ledger can be generated read-only from the current checkout without modifying product code or tenant records.
Every static page route has a route id, role/access classification, owner domain guess, and proof status.
Every probeable route records HTTP status, redirect class, timing, and whether it is under-500 reachable.
Navigation coverage distinguishes direct nav, parent coverage, consolidated hub coverage, command/rail coverage, and no known inbound path.

Critical domains are explicitly scored: Page X-Ray, Dinner Circles, Universal Rail Intelligence, Priority Queue, Commitment UI, Menu Intelligence, PIE, Client Intelligence, communications, lifecycle, ledger, navigation, Remy, automation, and CIL.
The JSON state can be diffed between runs and used by regression firewall or finish-check as an input.
The HTML report is readable offline and links back to screenshots, runtime JSON, route source files, and queue mapping.
Findings are split into keep, blocked, queue-candidate, rejected-expansion, and needs-user-approval buckets.
The report redacts or excludes secrets, cookies, auth tokens, private client data, and raw personal contact details.
No queue item is created unless the user explicitly asks to queue the spec.
verification_plan: Run git status before generation and record dirty files without overwriting unrelated work.
Run existing wiring audit and chef nav audit.
Run app typecheck when code surfaces changed.
Probe affected/static routes under the canonical dev server.
Capture a bounded browser evidence sample for representative public, chef, client, and admin/staff/partner/vendor routes when auth states exist.
Open generated HTML locally and verify links, thumbnails, and redaction notes.
Run regression firewall after integration if the ledger becomes a protected gate.
risks: A whole-site ledger can become noisy unless severity and proof-status rules are strict.
Role-auth proof may be blocked by stale or missing auth states.
Runtime probes must treat auth redirects, 401, and 403 as reachable for protected routes while still recording access class.
HTML reports can leak sensitive screenshots if redaction rules are weak.
Route consolidation rules can hide true orphan routes if hubs are overbroad.

suggested_queue_mapping.recommended_first_slice: Read-only generator producing reports/product-coherence/state.json and reports/product-coherence/index.html from route inventory, route policy, nav config, wiring audit, and affected-route probes.
